name: B10-0198/2026 (S&D) – Supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position ahead of the first EU-Armenia summit on 5 May 2026. It asks the EU to deepen cooperation with Armenia, support its reforms and elections, back peace with Azerbaijan, and help Armenia reduce its dependence on Russia. It also raises concerns about arrests of opposition figures and Russian interference. This is a statement of the Parliament's views and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament calls for deeper EU support, a peace treaty and election monitoring.
- **Who it affects:** Armenia's government, voters, media and civil society, plus Azerbaijan and Russia.
- **What happens next:** EU leaders meet Armenia on 5 May 2026; elections follow on 7 June 2026.
